panels.scene: WALT fills in a short one-page sheet at his kitchen table, pen in hand, thick-framed reading glasses on, calm and organised, morning light.
panels.caption: One page, filled in once.

panels.scene: WALT tapes the finished sheet inside a cupboard door in his kitchen, steady hands, unhurried.
panels.caption: Kept where it's easy to find.

panels.scene: WALT closes the cupboard door, satisfied, a small green kettle steaming gently on the stove behind him.
panels.caption: Free, ready if it's ever needed.
